storyCards.headline: Smokin' In The Boy's Room: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Brownsville Station's "Smokin' In The Boy's Room" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Smokin' In The Boy's Room was released in 1973.

"Smokin' In The Boy's Room" by Brownsville Station.

Chart story — peaked at #3 on the Hot 100.
